slides.headline: Before anyone sees your website, they've already seen your stars
Search your own business name.
slides.body: The first thing on the page is your rating and a handful of your reviews.

slides.headline: Search “[your service] near me”.
slides.body: The map shows three businesses. The stars sit right next to each name.

slides.headline: Google picks which reviews show.
slides.body: The default sort is “most relevant”, so one detailed 1-star can sit near the top for months.

slides.headline: Your website never gets its chance.
slides.body: Plenty of people decide from that panel alone and call whoever looks safest.

slides.headline: That's why one review can outweigh fifty good ones.
slides.body: It isn't about the average. It's about what's visible.

slides.headline: Send us the link. We'll tell you if it may have a case.
slides.sub: You only pay once it's gone.
